- Audit rights: Redwood proposes scoped, time-boxed audit rights for compliance (annual SOC 2 and targeted requests tied to specific incidents). We cannot agree to unlimited onsite audits; propose remote evidence exchange plus SOC 2 and pen-test summaries.
- Subprocessors: we accept a one-time notification + 30-day objection window for new subprocessors.
- Data transfers: we will rely on SCCs and maintain a list of EU-region-only deployments where data can be pinned.
- Indemnity/liability caps: we propose mutual caps tied to fees over prior 12 months.

I uploaded a clean mark to DocuSign and will send the envelope once Anna confirms signatory. For transparency, here's the DocuSign link (envelope will be live once I send): https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-CLINICA
